notes: The two italicized words again* and was* are folded onto ἔζησεν and ἀπολωλώς respectively. Marking again* added under rule 97 would require the projection to carry a reading the ASV excludes; SBLGNT.LUK.15.32.v032 and v033 are both underdetermined with the base compatible, so rule 12 forbids a new textual decision here and rule 11 keeps the italics evidence rather than a verdict. Reading again* as added remains defensible if the ASV's supplied marking is taken to reflect a shorter Greek than ἀνέζησεν.
ἔδει → it was meet and εὐφρανθῆναι → to make merry head on their meaning-bearing words under rules 17 and 91.
